title: US Secure Hash Algorithms (SHA and SHA-based HMAC and HKDF)
summary: This informational document reproduces the US Secure Hash Algorithms from Federal Information Processing Standards, along with SHA-based HMAC and HKDF. It provides reference code so others can implement and test them. These are widely used hash functions for security protocols.

eli5.summary: A hash turns any file into a short fingerprint. This gives the recipes and example code for several popular fingerprint machines used across the internet.
